entry.title: DLSS Super Resolution and Ray Reconstruction SDK v310.2.1
entry.content:
NVIDIA DLSS SDK 310.2.0 is now available for all developers:

  • Added Preset K to DLSS Super Resolution.
  • Added Preset E to DLSS Ray Reconstruction, which adds provision for Depth of Field Guide Buffer in addition to Subsurface Scattering (SSS)
  • Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements

entry.title: DLSS Super Resolution & Ray Reconstruction SDK 310.1.0
entry.content:
NVIDIA DLSS SDK 310.1.0 is now available for all developers:

  • Added support for DLSS Ray Reconstruction. This includes the new transformer architecture for increased stability and lighting detail with ray tracing.
  • Added a new DLSS Super Resolution model (in beta) featuring a transformer architecture for improved stability and motion detail.
